description: A DATA-ONLY received on a link made as the Called node is delivered to the client and acknowledged with an ACK-ONLY; a later copy of it is not delivered again but is acknowledged again.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ (S_BIND_ACCEPTED, MTU 2048). Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with an Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST, our accept goes out at 52000, and when that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made with the 16-bit family (B-0213, B-0142): window edges at their initial values (C-0782, C-0787), and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 runs (B-0215). At 61000 the peer's DATA-ONLY (type 9) with FSN 0, C_PDU START and END, TX WIN UWE and LWE set and a DATA C_PDU from SAP 5 to SAP 9 with 'ping' (EOT 20: the peer's 2-block transmission ends by 71000). IDLE(CONNECTED) goes to DATA(CONNECTED) (C-0658); FSN 0 is in the receive window (C-0779), so it is stored, RX UWE becomes 0 and RX LWE moves to 1 (C-0776, C-0778); the segment is a whole C_PDU (C-0513), delivered to the CAS with D_UNIDATA_INDICATION (C-0514). As the first DATA C_PDU received by ARQ on the link it stops cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 (B-0215), and the SIS hands the U_PDU to the client on SAP 9 with S_UNIDATA_INDICATION, transmission mode ARQ (A-0236). An acknowledgement is now owed (C-0174, C-1128). At 62000 the burst ends with the EOT prediction ahead: csma.vdcd_end to 71000, then LBT rule 1 (K-0067) and contention, 12000 ms. At 83000 the ACK-ONLY (type 10) goes: RX LWE 1, bitmap encoding, offset 0, and no bitmap bytes since nothing beyond RX LWE is held (C-0198, C-0201, C-0207, C-0211); 15 bytes, one block, EOT 10. No ARQ data of ours went, so no dts.ack_wait. At 96000 the peer sends FSN 0 again (it lost our acknowledgement). It lies behind RX LWE: not stored and not delivered again, and RX LWE does not move back (C-0777), but it owes an acknowledgement, which tells the peer RX LWE again (C-1126). The burst ends at 97000: csma.vdcd_end to 106000, LBT rule 1, contention 45000 ms (third draw), and at 151000 the same ACK-ONLY goes again. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Transmissions are zero filled: fill is P4-3's.
